Lava Flow Cocktail
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 31, 2009 - 11:53pm

Ingredients




2 cups frozen strawberries in juice, sliced and defrosted
2 cans coconut milk drink mix (Coco Lopez recommended)
2 cups pineapple juice
6 shots coconut rum or light ru
1 tray of ice

Preparation

1 Blend strawberries in a blender on high until smooth. Place 1/2 cup strawberry puree in the bottom of 4 hurricane or double rocks cocktail glasses. 2 Rinse blender and return to motor base. Place remaining ingredients in blender and blend on high until smooth. Pour pina coladas into glasses on top of the strawberry puree. The puree will run up through the pina colada, making a lava flow effect.

About


For mocktails, omit liquor and use a few extra ice cubes.
